name: Crafting (2x2 and table) and the recipe book
deviations: recipes whose results carry components (suspicious stew) make nothing
among several kinds of items for one ingredient, placing a recipe from the book takes them in the order the inventory first holds them; the official servers' choice varies from run to run
the recipes unlocked in one tick come in advancement id order (the official servers' order varies); advancement packets are not sent
placing a recipe from the book sends the grid's result once when it changed; the official servers send it again for each grid change the placement makes (the same window either way)
without the official data pack there are no recipes
note: The player's 2x2 grid and the crafting table's 3x3 grid craft with the shaped, shapeless and transmute recipes of the loaded data packs: the result follows the grid, every click mode takes it, ingredients are used and remainders kept, and the grids go back to the inventory on closing and drop when the player leaves or dies; 48 steps in the own window and 47 at crafting tables give the same windows as both official servers. The recipe book shows every recipe's display, and the data packs' recipe advancements unlock recipes as both official servers do (items in the inventory, filled slots, the first tick, water, crafting, /recipe), with seen recipes and the books' settings kept; recipes placed from the book fill the own grid, crafting tables and furnaces, with ghosts for missing items, as both official servers place them, and a crafting table makes the placed recipe until its grid changes; with doLimitedCrafting on, the grids make only known recipes, a result already shown staying until the grid changes. Repairing, armor dye, banner copying, shield decoration, firework stars, rockets, star fades, book and map cloning, map extending, tipped arrows and decorated pots are made at crafting tables and in crafters as on both official servers (an extended map becoming a new map with the map ids each way of taking it uses), special recipes matching in id order with the others; recipes match and the book numbers them by the id's path, then its namespace, as both official servers order recipes of several namespaces; and each change a click makes to a grid's slot sends its result again as they do
